[
زَاخِرَةٌ a subst. from زَاخِرٌ, rendered such by the affix ة.] زَوَاخِرُ [is its pl., and] signifies Watercourses; or channels of water. (JK.) ―
-b2- And Herbs: so in the saying, اِكْتَهَلَتْ زَوَاخِرُ الوَادِى [The herbs of the valley became tall, full-grown, or of their full height and in blossom]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
